title: Keyless Auto Training, Lift Cube, Buy Aura, Buy Material
features:
Auto Training - Automatically performs push-ups at maximum speed and collects pop-ups while letting you freely walk and jump.

Auto Lift Cube - Teleports to the best cube you can lift and instantly completes lifts for fast strength and cash.

Auto Buy Aura - Automatically purchases the highest aura upgrade as soon as you have enough cash.

Auto Buy Material - Rigged chest rolls: manipulates drop chances to guarantee and buy the next best arm materials until maxed out.

Auto Buy Next WalkSpeed - Automatically buys the next movement speed upgrade whenever it is affordable.

WalkSpeed - Adjusts your character's walking speed and locks it at your chosen value.

Menu Key - Lets you change the keybind used to open and close the menu.

Unload Menu - Completely stops all farming features, restores default settings, and removes the menu interface.
